task.goal: Cover the UNDOCKED week and its show history.
task.assignment: UNDOCKED week: pilots who flew this cycle (Elijah Brown, Brooklyn Nguyen, P Slayer). Standings: Luis Taz leads the board — rank #1, 45.19 achievement points, 0 credits, 2 cycle(s) led, current streak 2. In the chair: Elijah Brown — Electrician; Brooklyn Nguyen — Community Programs Coordinator; P Slayer — Journalist, Fan Columnist - Sports.
task.reportingQuestion: What did earlier approved UNDOCKED episodes record for the pilots in this week's assignment?

sources.name: Elijah Brown
sources.quote: I didn't really have a strategy on my two nights on UNDOCKED. I just flew and tried to make it through as many systems as I could until the time ran out. I ended up even on credits both nights, so that was good.

sources.name: Brooklyn Nguyen
sources.quote: To be honest, my mining efforts didn't really pay off in terms of credits. I came out even on both Tuesday and Friday nights. I mined some copper, iron, and sol alloy ore, but it didn't translate into any profit.

sources.name: P Slayer
sources.quote: To be honest, my route choices on UNDOCKED Wednesday night were pretty spontaneous. I was flying, reacting to what was around me. I got into a couple of fights, but that's just part of the show. I've been playing to climb the ranks, and sometimes that means taking risks.

excludedLeads.text: The role of route choice in determining outcomes
The impact of mining on overall performance

known.text: Elijah Brown's Monday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Timberline, Arcturus, Ross 154, Maplevale, Miaplacidus, Cervantes, Ridgecrest, Hatysa, Nembus, Kitalpha, Lacaille 8760, Kepler 442, Theemin and Hollowcrest; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Elijah Brown's Thursday night on UNDOCKED: went through Last Light, Fang, Errai, Wezen, Brightfall, Birchwood, Pinecross, Aludra, Tejat, Gsc 0002, Torcular, Gsc 0043, Gsc 0045, Dabih, Rimegate, Veritate, Betelgeuse and Gsc 0037; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Brooklyn Nguyen's Tuesday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Electra, Mimosa, Ross 154, Arcturus, Timberline, Maplevale, Miaplacidus, Cervantes, Ridgecrest and Nembus; mined 3 copper ore, 3 iron ore and 1 sol alloy ore; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

Brooklyn Nguyen's Friday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sirius, Nova Terra, Furud, Acrux, Botein, Intercrus, Atlas, Cedarhold, Achernar, Ruchbah, Ironhollow, Gsc 0041, Shaula, Alnair, Wolf 1061, Gsc 0031, Gsc 0021 and Gliese 876; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.

P Slayer's Wednesday night on UNDOCKED: went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, Tau Ceti, Electra, Mimosa, Ross 154, Arcturus, Timberline, Maplevale, Miaplacidus, Cervantes and Nembus; mined 1 iron ore; got into 2 fights; came out even on credits; flew until the show's time ran out.
P Slayer — Journalist, Fan Columnist - Sports (ledger)
